topic.label: Education
topic.desc: Education: how people learn and how teaching, curriculum, assessment and institutions can support that learning.

concepts: Cognitive, social and motivational processes by which people acquire knowledge and skills.
Sequencing objectives, content and activities into coherent courses and units.
Designing formative and summative assessments and judging their validity, reliability and fairness.
Classroom methods, discussion, active learning and management that make instruction effective.
Supporting learners with disabilities, language needs and diverse backgrounds through equitable design.
Funding, governance, accountability and reform of schools and higher education, informed by evidence.
skills: Matches an instructional situation to relevant learning theories and checks claims against empirical studies.
Analyses materials for intrinsic and extraneous load and checks revisions against cognitive load principles.
Identifies motivational barriers for learners and checks proposed supports against self-determination research.
Writes measurable learning objectives at chosen cognitive levels and checks each verb against Bloom taxonomy.
Builds units from goals to evidence to activities and checks alignment among objectives, assessments and lessons.
Maps lessons to curriculum standards and checks coverage gaps and duplication.
Constructs analytic rubrics with performance levels and checks inter-rater agreement on sample work.
Computes item difficulty, discrimination and reliability statistics and checks for biased items.
Writes actionable feedback on student work and checks it targets the stated criteria.
Designs lessons with active learning structures and checks time, roles and student tasks are explicit.
Adapts tasks for varied readiness and interest and checks every variant still meets the objective.
Reviews materials against UDL guidelines and checks multiple means of engagement, representation and expression.
Proposes accommodations for documented learner needs and checks them against legal and assessment requirements.
Evaluates a reform using causal studies and checks effect sizes and study quality.
Assesses a learning tool for pedagogical fit, accessibility and evidence and checks claims against research.
mcp: Create classroom-ready K-12 math diagrams in Claude
Enhance responses with scholarly research and citations
